events.title: Final Playtest — Ends October 30
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has participated in the VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE Playtest.The Playtest will end on October 30 as development moves into final release preparation for the November 6 launch.The latest Playtest build includes the new LOADOUT system, allowing you to select your equipment within the available capacity before each mission.If you registered for the Playtest but have not tried the game yet, this is a good opportunity to play the latest version before release.Feedback, bug report
